recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Do not restore ShareableCodeSystem in core for FHIR-32634 unless the work group revisits FHIR-37959; if the current CRMI ShareableCodeSystem profile needs the knowledgeCapability slice, handle that in CRMI/profile-maintenance work.
issue_request: FHIR-32634 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Vocab R5 issue requesting cqf-knowledgeCapability and cqf-knowledgeRepresentationLevel extension slices on ShareableCodeSystem, each 0..* and mustSupport.
initial_application: The Jira comment linked PR #2068, merged as 0d4401be. The relevant implementation commit 93fadfaa updated source/codesystem/structuredefinition-profile-shareablecodesystem.xml and added a mustSupport cqf-knowledgeRepresentationLevel slice; git and R5 history checks did not find a corresponding cqf-knowledgeCapability slice on ShareableCodeSystem.
additional_context: FHIR-37959 is a later Applied/Persuasive R6 decision to remove the Shareable, Publishable, Computable, and Executable profiles from core FHIR and maintain them in CRMI with unchanged canonical URIs. Current CodeSystem core IG source has no profile resources, current source has no ShareableCodeSystem StructureDefinition file, and the Shareable pattern narrative tells applications to use CRMI profiles.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. Reintroducing ShareableCodeSystem or adding extension slices in core would reverse the later profile migration decision rather than correct the current build.
